summary.title: The Shaping Pyramids: Unworthy in the City in Yellow
summary.synopsis: The Weft tours the 13th Realm's soul-storage memory cells with Yudan, learning the mechanics of the reincarnation cycle and the Lighthouse's prison system. They sow propaganda among the Sundom to lay groundwork for a future coup, then teleport to the City in Yellow (Ilkain) to confront the Deep — only to find a decaying, alien city of cloaked figures who deem them 'unworthy,' pyramids that demand they be 'shaped,' and hostile plant and fungal guardians awakened when Don punches a pyramid.
key_beats: Yudan leads The Weft deep into the 13th Realm's core to tour the memory cell — a massive sphere with tree-like rods holding ~10 million compressed souls on needle tips, each needle's length representing lives lived. Destroying a dew-drop soul destroys it permanently; the 13th Realm cannot reach into the Lighthouse.
The party learns Rampart's soul is permanently lost (disconnected and grabbed by the beacon they destroyed), while Grimm and Ashmon's souls are present. Boride was also disconnected.

Don researches the 13th Realm's power hierarchy: kitchens and creature comforts go offline first, the locomotion and barrier systems next, and the memory cells are last — designed to survive on a fraction of one Thessian's power. The 13th Realm currently runs at ~50% (Beast fully consumed, plus fractions of Deep and Nox).
Lev successfully sows rumors across the 13th Realm about The Weft's legendary power, planting seeds for a future coup and earning diplomatic bonuses for the party.
Discussion reveals 71 people have ascended on Allthane; 70 remain trapped in Lighthouse prisons (Savik is dead). The Lighthouse is far more powerful than the 13th Realm and operates autonomously.
The party performs a Fortifying Brew ritual (super crit) and shares brew with 13th Realm inhabitants before teleporting to the City in Yellow.

They arrive in Ilkain — an alien, decaying city with melting gold-roofed buildings, an impossible starfield sky, shambling yellow-cloaked figures who point and say 'unworthy,' and a lighthouse at the top of a hill that telescopes away when approached.

A cloaked figure tells Divex he must be 'shaped' at the 'shaping pyramids.' The party walks the city's outer ring, cataloguing six pyramids: Spire of Origin, Spire of Sky, Spire of Cycle, Spire of Geometry, Spire of History, and Spire of Hierarchy.

Lev peers into the cognitive realm near the Spire of History and encounters an indescribable infectious color, taking exotic damage before fending off the incursion. Don punches the Spire of History, aging the entire city into a wasteland and triggering combat.

Combat erupts against Sards (lightning trees that cast Chain Lightning and Storm of Vengeance) and Terra Trachus creatures (fungal beings firing sticky spores). Lev fells a Sard with massive thaumaturge strikes; Divex uses Desiccate to devastating effect. Combat remains ongoing at session's end.
The party is mid-fight with one remaining Sard and one Terra Trachus in the decayed wasteland version of the City in Yellow.
locations: 13th Realm (planet ship) — command deck, subdeck 18,412, memory cell observation room
City in Yellow (Ilkain) — central plaza, outer ring road, Spire of History, decaying wasteland version of the city
items: The Needle (weapon for confronting the Deep, given to Henrik)
summary.cliffhanger: Mid-combat in the decayed wasteland of the City in Yellow — the party faces a remaining Sard (casting Storm of Vengeance and Chain Lightning) and a Terra Trachus (firing sticky spores), with the fight unresolved at session's end.
